x: Lacey): Derek Boosey, after a season of injury, triple jumps for Great Britain in the match against Sweden at White City on Sept 14th. Derek was second with a Club record leap of 51'-8¼" [?]--only 3¼" [?] behind winner Alsop.

So far only two athletes have been chosen for Tokyo in the Triple Jump, Alsop and Ralph who have marks of 52'6½" and 52'4¾" respectively. If Derek can pull something out of the bag there is still a chance of him going yet.

Of the home contingent only Alsop and Boosey had achieved the Mexico mark but foreigners Ciochina (Rumania) and Cziffra (Hungary) were 54' plus and 53' plus jumpers respectively.

Several of Belgrave's Surrey team were in far from the best of shape, Roger Alsop and Alaster Stewart just about overcoming injury, Yacin Yusuf only recently returning to running after sickness and Graham Adams and Jim Estall both having had low key summers.
